description.value: Afghan Kitchen is a family-run restaurant in South Surrey built around the owner's personal journey from Kabul to Canada, serving traditional Afghan dishes made entirely from his mother's recipes. The restaurant earned the South Surrey & White Rock Chamber of Commerce Business of the Year (Medium) award for 2023 and was featured on the Food Network in March 2021. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a welcoming sit-down dining experience with catering available for group events.
